about: The Strayed supply crate placed in front of the player when the level starts.

columns.offset: metres from the player's head, [right, up, forward]; up is then snapped to the ground below
columns.contents: items.id list standing inside the open-top crate
columns.openBy: open_top = items stand inside and are grabbed straight out
columns.oncePerRun: true = one crate per game session (respawns only after a scene reload)
columns.strayedTexture: Strayed Texture2D on the crate's boards (read from the player's install like the items)
